## About
J & B Auto Detailing is an owner-operated detail shop at 2903-A Southampton Road in NE Philadelphia. When you bring your vehicle to us, you're working with someone who has a real stake in how it turns out.
We give your car the same attention to detail we use on our own vehicles, and we're particular about the products we use. Besides detailing, we handle headlight reconditioning, wheel repair, paintless dent removal, overspray removal and more.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 315 Google reviews. If you have a question, give us a call. We'd rather talk it through with you in person.

## Services
- Hand wash and wax: Careful hand washing and waxing for the outside of your vehicle. One reviewer had a wash, clay bar and wax done on a Toyota Tundra.
- Upholstery cleaning: Interior cleaning for seats and carpets. One customer said we removed stains and mold from the carpets and seats.
- Odor removal: Getting lingering smells out of your interior.
- Engine cleaning: Degreasing and cleaning under the hood. One reviewer had rodent droppings and dirt cleaned out of the engine compartment.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent repair without repainting.
- Headlight reconditioning: Restoring cloudy or faded headlights.
- Aluminum wheel repair: Repair for damaged aluminum wheels.
- Overspray removal: Removing paint overspray from your vehicle's finish.
- Pinstriping: A specialty touch beyond a standard detail.
- Insurance claims: Call us to ask how we can help with your insurance claim work.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Any vehicle. We work on cars, trucks, boats and even RVs.

Q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
A: Yes, our site lists free pickup and delivery. Give us a call to set it up.

Q: Should I bring my car in before a lease return?
A: Yes. If your lease is ending, visit us first. We specialize in getting off-lease vehicles looking their best so you can return your car without worries.
